$comment: How the tree is configured and tested, as CMake, an IDE and `omw` read it. A visible preset is
`<flavour>-<system>` and inherits the flavour, the system and `common`, in that order: the earlier one wins
a variable both set. Hidden presets are parts. Each flavour builds in `build-<flavour>`. Version 10 is the
first that takes a `$comment`.

configurePresets.name: common
$comment: Every flavour. The CS, the wizard and the two importers stay off outside `full`; `omw setup` turns
the ini importer on. ccache drives GCC and MSVC, and the compile database is what an editor reads.

configurePresets.name: linux
$comment: Linux supplies recastnavigation, Google Test and mold. `RelWithDebInfo` is `-O2 -g`, not CMake's,
whose `-DNDEBUG` drops every assert. C++ static libraries are thin archives (`ar T`): copying the
game's 1.3 GB of objects cost six seconds of every relink, and no library is installed. Ninja
creates an archive whole, so the append rule is unused. Warnings
are errors through upstream's switch, which leaves `extern/` alone.

configurePresets.name: windows
$comment: Upstream's prebuilt vcpkg set, which `omw` fetches into deps/ at the tag CI/deps_versions.msvc.sh
pins (VCPKG_TAG). It lacks recastnavigation, Google Test, SQLite and yaml-cpp, which CMake fetches,
and Qt, so no launcher, and SDL3, which CMake builds. vcpkg's DLL copying is off, since `omw` copies
the whole runtime. Precompiled headers are off: ccache cannot cache through them (593 of 623 backend
compiles missed). `RelWithDebInfo` is `-O2 -Z7`: CMake's carries `/DNDEBUG`, and `-Z7` is the debug
format ccache can cache. Warnings are errors through upstream's switch. The paths name nothing
unless `omw` exports the two versions.

configurePresets.name: no-tools
$comment: The content tools and the launcher off, for flavours that never run them. Debug keeps them, so the
launcher's [RTX] page can be built.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.$comment: Every assert, with the tests: the everyday build.

configurePresets.name: release
$comment: `-O3 -DNDEBUG`, no tests: the build a number is quoted from. Each system adds line tables and frame
pointers on its visible preset.

configurePresets.name: asan
$comment: Debug under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, as upstream runs its tests. Linux
only: MSVC's sanitizer is unmeasured here. The options it needs are its test preset's. `-Wmaybe-
uninitialized` and `-Wstringop-overread` are off here alone: GCC's manual says `-fsanitize` gives
flow warnings false positives, GCC 16 reported libstdc++'s `std::regex`, and GCC 13 a one-element
vector assigned from a braced list. Debug checks the same code.

configurePresets.name: full
$comment: Every program, the CS and its tests among them, every suite and the benchmarks: what CI builds.
Listed first where inherited, so what it turns on beats what `common` and `windows` turn off.

configurePresets.name: package
$comment: A release archive: release without tests, with the launcher, the wizard and the two importers, and
no CS. `OPENMW_LOCAL_INSTALL` is upstream's portable layout, everything in one directory. Listed
first where inherited, so what it turns on beats what `windows` turns off.

configurePresets.name: debug-linux
$comment: The test binaries at `-Og`: `cmake/Tests.cmake` says why.

configurePresets.name: release-linux
$comment: `-g1` line tables cost nothing at runtime and let a profile name a line; frame pointers cost less
than the run-to-run spread and let perf walk the stack. On the measured build, so a profile
explains the frames the benchmark timed.

configurePresets.name: release-windows
$comment: `-Z7` with `-DEBUG` gives a profiler line tables, and `-Oy-` keeps frame pointers. Dashes, because
Git Bash turns `/O2` into a path. In `CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_INIT`, so CMake still appends its own
(`/EHsc`, `/machine:x64`).

configurePresets.name: full-windows
configurePresets.$comment: Qt for the CS, the launcher and the wizard, and the link-time optimisation upstream's Windows build takes.

configurePresets.name: package-linux
$comment: `-g1` for the symbols `omw archive` publishes, so a player's crash dump names a function and a
line. No runtime cost.

configurePresets.name: package-windows
$comment: Qt for the launcher and the wizard, which `omw` fetches into deps/ at QT_VER. `-Z7` with `-DEBUG`
writes each PDB beside its executable, for the symbols `omw archive` publishes; the install leaves
them out.

testPresets.name: tests
$comment: Every test run: a failing test's output shown, and a build that registers no test is a failure.
Five minutes a suite, ten times the slowest one under the sanitizers: a test that hangs, as one
of `openmw-tests` does on Windows now and then, fails with the test it was in, where a job would
wait out its three hours and say nothing. Every suite runs in a new order each time, so a test
that leans on what an earlier one left fails at once: a test that captured stderr and never
gave it back broke every later death test in its binary, and ran in upstream's order for years.
The run prints its seed, and `GTEST_RANDOM_SEED` repeats it.

testPresets.name: sanitizers
$comment: `protect_shadow_gap=0` is required: ASan's shadow gap covers part of what the NVIDIA driver maps,
and `vkCreateDevice` fails, which the RTX tests would read as a skip. The leak check is off,
because the driver, the loader, the layers and dbus hold heaps for the life of the process;
`ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1` from the environment turns it back on. A finding fails the run. `omw`
runs every asan program under these.
